questions.question: What did Ezra proclaim at the river Ahava before the journey?
options: A great feast before setting out
A census of all who would travel
A call to arms against the road's dangers
A fast, to seek a safe journey from God
questions.answer: A fast, to seek a safe journey from God

questions.question: Why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen?
options: He had told the king God's hand is on all who seek him
He feared the long journey through the desert
He had already spent all the silver given him
The king had forbidden any escort to go with him
questions.answer: He had told the king God's hand is on all who seek him

questions.question: Ezra entrusted the silver, gold, and vessels to the priests for the journey.

The hand of their God was on them to protect them from the _____ along the way.
